samplePolicy: 100-level chapter first/last maps, every boss map, and enemy unlock boundaries. Each sampled portal direction idle-tested for 60 simulated seconds; other portals have data checks only.
dynamicSampleVersion: 1000 maps and five enemy ranks, before the final wind-wall physics and player-shield additions.

finalVersionRecheck.samplePolicy: Explicit final-version smoke maps 1, 100, 867 and 1000; all four portal directions idle-tested for 60 simulated seconds per map. Other portals checked as data only.

coverageNote: The 54-map stratified sample covers 216 distinct portal directions. The final version repeats 16 of these directions on 4 maps; this is not a 4000-direction simulation. Final-version geometry data checks still cover all 1000 maps / 4000 portal locations.
version: Legacy five-family enemy build with player shields and wind-wall fix
versionNote: Preserved historical evidence. These gameplay results were produced before the 100-type catalogue and are not coverage of the new enemy types.
geometryVersion: Legacy maze maps before the open grass arena and giant-bean redesign
openArenaNote: Historical evidence only. Does not verify the current open grass arena layouts, giant bean contact radii or current gameplay.
